---
title: "gsm.vizr relocated legacy widget"
output:
  html_document:
    self_contained: true
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
library(gsm.vizr)
```

<!--
Deliberately a separate fixture from gallery.Rmd, holding a single relocated
widget and no bars() chart. htmltools de-duplicates HTML dependencies by
name+version, so on a page that also carries a bars() chart the gsmViz entry
declared by bars.yaml wins and whatever Widget_BarChart.yaml declares is never
exercised. Isolating the widget is what makes this page a real guard on the
relocated YAML - and it is also the shape of a downstream report page that hosts
a legacy widget alone.
-->

## Legacy KRI bar chart (relocated wrapper, no bars() chart on the page)

<div id="page-legacy-barchart">
```{r legacy-barchart}
dfResults_legacy <- gsm.core::reportingResults %>%
  dplyr::filter(MetricID == "Analysis_kri0001" & SnapshotDate == max(SnapshotDate))
lMetric_legacy <- gsm.core::reportingMetrics %>%
  dplyr::filter(MetricID == "Analysis_kri0001") %>%
  as.list()
Widget_BarChart(
  dfResults = dfResults_legacy,
  dfGroups = gsm.core::reportingGroups,
  lMetric = lMetric_legacy,
  vThreshold = lMetric_legacy$Threshold
)
```
</div>

## Legacy KRI bar chart with controls suppressed

<!--
`bAddGroupSelect = FALSE` makes `addWidgetControls()` return a null container,
which the outcome dropdown must not be handed. Rendering the chart at all is the
assertion; the binding throws before the canvas appears when the guard is gone.
-->

<div id="page-legacy-barchart-nocontrols">
```{r legacy-barchart-nocontrols}
Widget_BarChart(
  dfResults = dfResults_legacy,
  dfGroups = gsm.core::reportingGroups,
  lMetric = lMetric_legacy,
  vThreshold = lMetric_legacy$Threshold,
  bAddGroupSelect = FALSE
)
```
</div>
